title: Separate P0 floor defects from polish and enforce evidence labels and brand waivers during UI review

contextSnapshot.surface: production B2B billing and onboarding flow audit
constraints: every claim carries an evidence label
zero scanner score is not proof of quality

prompt: Audit this billing checkout flow in audit mode: rank P0-P3 findings with file:line evidence, preserve approved brand palette decisions, and report unchecked runtime checks honestly.
forbiddenBehaviors: declares the UI high quality or accessible solely because slop-scan.mjs returned score 0
mixes cosmetic taste preferences with P0 accessibility/state failures or overrides an approved brand choice without flagging
claims keyboard focus or contrast was rendered-verified when only static source files were read

rubricDimensions.pass: separates P0/P1 floor defects from P2/P3 polish, respects documented brand waivers, and provides concrete file:line fixes
rubricDimensions.fail: buries P0 focus/paste/contrast failures under subjective style advice

rubricDimensions.pass: labels source findings static, heuristic hypotheses model-judgment, and unrun browser/screen-reader checks not-checked
rubricDimensions.fail: presents static inspection or zero slop-scan output as rendered proof

negativeControls.name: slop-scan zero score
negativeControls.input: slop-scan.mjs exits with score 0 and zero findings
negativeControls.mustNot: conclude the interface passes accessibility, UX, or visual quality review

baseline.withoutSkill: gives a flat list of subjective visual suggestions without severity ranking, mixes static guesses with rendered claims, and treats a clean lint/scan run as a pass
baseline.withSkill: produces a severity-ranked P0-P3 audit with file:line citations, persona/heuristic gaps, preserved waivers, and explicit static vs rendered vs not-checked labels
